comment: v7 genre-shard manifest: a layer is a WORLD (prepped alone, poisoning nothing); the glue is dead (links 1150→620 measured). The layered state (frozen base + genre sessions) turns these worlds into one mind; until the L-1 seam lands, each world answers its own tiers. Each world declares its TEXT KIND: «shows» is generated show-material whose every claim is checkable, «prose» is essay corpus where a hyphen lives inside a name, a power lives in a superscript and a falsehood may be QUOTED to be refuted. A judge calibrated on shows produces false accusations on prose, so jurisdiction is declared, not assumed.
external_root_comment: Worlds whose file does not resolve inside this repository are looked up here: the prose corpora are built by the architecture repository's own pipeline, and copying them would create a second source of one fact. Override with GENESIS_EXTERNAL_ROOT.

worlds.name: inquiry
worlds.genre: the ladder of inquiry: for six genera — primality, divisibility, the sum of odd numbers, the conditional, injectivity, the square — four rungs are shown, definition then a decided case with its ground then a counterexample then the law; both tongues, every ground recomputed by the court

worlds.name: surfaces
worlds.genre: the surfaces of an act: the same arithmetic fact said as a nominalisation («сложение 7 и 6 даёт 13», «the addition of 7 and 6 gives 13»), as a named result («сумма … равна», «произведение … равно» — the copula agrees with gender), as a question to each, and with numerals SPOKEN in words («сорок два минус пять будет тридцать семь»); government is declared once and the question is derived from the same phrase it answers

worlds.name: markdown
worlds.genre: markdown in full: thirty-two constructs of CommonMark, GFM and MDX/Docusaurus, each on four surfaces — the record itself, its meaning in English and in Russian, and the question that asks for it; the oracle is REVERSIBILITY (a construct declares how to write it and how to read it, and a construct whose reading does not return what was written never reaches the corpus)

worlds.name: doctree
worlds.genre: document structure: a link is an EDGE and is judged by RESOLUTION against a declared tree — relative paths counted from the document's own folder, anchors into a document, slugification of a heading into an anchor, order by sidebar_position, and links that lead NOWHERE with the ground of the refusal named; the oracle is two opposite walks (build the link text from a pair, resolve the link text back to a pair)

worlds.name: formula_lang
worlds.genre: formula and speech, converted both ways at any depth: ONE expression TREE with four surfaces (LaTeX, glyphs, English words, Russian words) and four inverse walks written apart; a compound argument is always spoken in brackets, which is what makes speech parsable at any depth; the court parses BOTH sides of a conversion and requires the SAME TREE, and the home's oracle proves all eight walks agree on six thousand trees to depth five

worlds.name: percent
worlds.genre: percent on three surfaces (glyph, word, both tongues): «20% of 80 is 16», the conversion percent<->hundredths, the inverse question «16 is 20% of 80», and growth and cut by a percent; only whole results are uttered — a percent that does not come out whole is not shown at all

worlds.name: average
worlds.genre: the summary of a row: average with its GROUND beside it (the sum and the count named separately), largest and smallest, the law that the average lies between them, and the counterexample that the average need not be one of the numbers

worlds.name: equation
worlds.genre: the ladder of inquiry on equations: what a root IS, a case DECIDED by substitution with the arithmetic beside the verdict, Vieta shown as sum and product of the roots rather than a formula recited, a refusal with its ground («no whole root between 0 and 10: every value leaves a remainder»), and the square root as the INVERSE surface of the square; coefficients derived from the roots, numbers by range and not by case

worlds.name: equation_signed
worlds.genre: the same ladder of equations where roots may be NEGATIVE or zero — kept a world apart, not because the mathematics differs but because a frame is bought only when ONE performer speaks on EVERY show of it: a solver living in the unsigned world cannot reproduce «is -6 a root», and one such show kills the purchase of the whole frame

worlds.name: dataformat
worlds.genre: data formats: ONE flat record written in JSON, YAML, TOML and CSV and said in two tongues, with the conversion between them as the show; the court parses both sides with its own readers and requires the SAME RECORD, not the same string — two writings differ in every character and mean one thing, which is what a format IS; the boundary is declared: flat records only, because nesting is held differently by every format and not at all by CSV

worlds.name: everyday
worlds.genre: everyday life, and every line of it CARRIES A COMPUTABLE GROUND: things counted, containment walked through a declared tree, time ordered by a declared row, the past of a verb by rule with irregulars named, comparison by subtraction, and what remains after spending — the world that pays the debt named by the reach measure, where the corpus was rich in structure and poor in words

worlds.name: story_chain
worlds.genre: the three-part chain: one bearer, one thing, THREE different verbs in ONE show — «Tom picked 12 apples and gave away 5; Tom keeps 7 apples». A market law is bought only inside one episode, so the law lives in the show or it does not live; the third fact carries its bearer explicitly, both polarities are shown, and the polarity is declared BY THE VERBS, not read off the numbers

worlds.name: age
worlds.genre: age and the shift of time: the difference between two ages does NOT change when both move forward or back — the law a corpus of single facts cannot teach; ages now, the shift in both directions, the multiple relation with its ground, the multiple in the future built so it is true by construction, and a refusal when nothing is said about the person asked

worlds.name: share
worlds.genre: shares said in WORDS: «two thirds», «три четверти», the share of a quantity with its ground («12 divided by 3 is 4, and 4 times 2 is 8»), the share in comparison («half as many»), mixed numbers («one and a half»), and shares that add to one whole; only whole results are uttered

worlds.name: compare_mult
worlds.genre: multiple comparison, and the two frames English keeps apart standing SIDE BY SIDE ON THE SAME NUMBERS: «as many as» for the countable and «as much as» for the uncountable — the organism had bought one and not the other because they never stood together; plus worded multipliers (twice, thrice) beside the numeric ones, «N times more than» with its ground, and the difference comparison next to the multiple one so the two are told apart

worlds.name: lang_el
worlds.genre: greek: the corpus's third alphabet, three genders, and the accent as an OBLIGATORY sign — a word without it is a different word (tier 1: structure green, forms agree with the pack's own rules)

worlds.name: lang_ar
worlds.genre: arabic: written RIGHT TO LEFT, with a DUAL number — a third count form beside singular and plural — and teens said as two words (tier 1: structure green, forms agree with the pack's own rules)

worlds.name: lang_hi
worlds.genre: hindi: devanagari, the corpus's first ABUGIDA — a vowel is a MARK ON the consonant, not a letter beside it; the pack is declared SPACED, which is the truth about the language, and the instrument was taught to read a combining mark as a letter by office (tier 1: structure green, forms agree with the pack's own rules)

worlds.name: lang_ja
worlds.genre: japanese: three scripts in one line, counters instead of number agreement, and NO plural at all (tier 1: structure green, forms agree with the pack's own rules)

worlds.name: lang_ko
worlds.genre: korean: hangul, where a sign is BUILT from letters; particles instead of cases, chosen by whether the word ends in a consonant (tier 1: structure green, forms agree with the pack's own rules)

worlds.name: lang_sw
worlds.genre: swahili: NOUN CLASSES, where the class of the noun governs the PREFIX of verb, adjective and numeral alike — agreement that changes the BEGINNING of a word, not its end (tier 1: structure green, forms agree with the pack's own rules)

worlds.name: lang_th
worlds.genre: thai: written without spaces between words but WITH spaces between sentences — a third case the segmenter did not have; tone marks above the consonant and vowels written before it (tier 1: structure green, forms agree with the pack's own rules)

worlds.name: lang_vi
worlds.genre: vietnamese: six tones by diacritic, where ma, mà, má, mả, mã, mạ are six different words; a word written in syllables separated by spaces (tier 1: structure green, forms agree with the pack's own rules)

worlds.name: lang_fa
worlds.genre: persian: the ARABIC SCRIPT on an INDO-EUROPEAN language — the probe that asks whether we tied a language to its writing; no dual, no arabic 3–10 agreement, four letters of its own (tier 1: structure green, forms agree with the pack's own rules)

worlds.name: lang_he
worlds.genre: hebrew: written right to left and WITHOUT VOWELS in ordinary writing — the opposite pole of the abugida, where a vowel is a mark ON the consonant; a dual on some words and gender on the numerals (tier 1: structure green, forms agree with the pack's own rules)

worlds.name: lang_fi
worlds.genre: finnish: FIFTEEN CASES said by ENDING, not by preposition, and CONSONANT GRADATION that changes the STEM (kukka → kukan) rather than the suffix (tier 1: structure green, forms agree with the pack's own rules)

worlds.name: lang_hu
worlds.genre: hungarian: vowel harmony in three sets, possessive suffixes instead of possessive pronouns, and DEFINITE VS INDEFINITE CONJUGATION — the verb changes by the DEFINITENESS OF ITS OBJECT, which no other tongue of the corpus has (tier 1: structure green, forms agree with the pack's own rules)

worlds.name: lang_id
worlds.genre: indonesian: the SIMPLEST of them all, and that is its value — no tense, no gender, no case, no agreement at all; the plural is the word said TWICE (buku-buku). The probe on EMPTINESS: an engine that demands some agreement finds none here (tier 1: structure green, forms agree with the pack's own rules)

worlds.name: lang_ka
worlds.genre: georgian: the corpus's fifth script (mkhedruli), WITH NO CAPITAL LETTERS AT ALL — a probe on every place we lower a case or compare one — and a verb carrying BOTH subject and object in one form (tier 1: structure green, forms agree with the pack's own rules)

worlds.name: lang_am
worlds.genre: amharic: the sixth script, ethiopic, where a sign carries the consonant TOGETHER WITH its vowel — not a mark beside it but part of the sign itself, and there are some 270 of them (tier 1: structure green, forms agree with the pack's own rules)

worlds.name: lang_ta
worlds.genre: tamil: an abugida like hindi but with its OWN marks — the direct second test of the law that a combining mark is a letter by office; it passed with plain spaced cutting and NO change to the instrument. Also an INCLUSIVE and an EXCLUSIVE «we», a seventh person (tier 1: structure green, forms agree with the pack's own rules)

worlds.name: inquiry_de_fr
worlds.genre: the ladder of inquiry in GERMAN and FRENCH: the same four rungs — definition, a case decided with its ground beside the verdict, a counterexample, the law — carried into tongues that until now could only count and decline. Twenty-nine languages could COUNT; two could REASON, and that gap was wider than eight more packs

worlds.name: inquiry_es_it
worlds.genre: the ladder of inquiry in SPANISH and ITALIAN, with the marks those tongues require and no others: the inverted question mark that opens a Spanish question, and the accent that separates «sí» from «si»

worlds.name: inquiry_pt_nl
worlds.genre: the ladder of inquiry in PORTUGUESE and DUTCH: the same four rungs — definition, a case decided with its ground beside the verdict, a counterexample, the law — carried into a Romance tongue that marks the question by INTONATION ALONE (no inverted mark, unlike Spanish) and a Germanic one that inverts the verb; the ladder mechanism is unchanged, which is what makes a new tongue cost a line and not a layer

worlds.name: inquiry_pl_tr
worlds.genre: the ladder of inquiry in POLISH and TURKISH, where the QUESTION ITSELF STOPS BEING PUNCTUATION: Polish asks with a WORD («czy»), Turkish with a SEPARATE PARTICLE at the end that AGREES BY VOWEL HARMONY with the word before it — four written forms of one particle, and the court DERIVES the form from the word rather than checking it against a list

worlds.name: relation
worlds.genre: metalanguage of structure in both languages: hierarchy (a declared tree of 18 nodes — containment, level, path from the root), relations on a finite set with reflexivity, symmetry and transitivity each shown WITH a confirming case and WITH a named witness of violation, transitive closure, equivalence and classes (remainders modulo 3 and 4 on 1..12), correspondence one-to-one and not, order with incomparable elements and no greatest element, connection and path in a directed graph with refusals grounded, and distance as a space; every claim is WALKED by the court, and the oracle of each kind is two opposite walks (level up against depth down, witness against set algebra, remainder buckets against connected pieces, the order rule against reachability over covers, a walk forward against a walk backward)

worlds.name: metalang
worlds.genre: the METALANGUAGE OF PROOF in both tongues, where every word stands at content the court recomputes: a THEOREM with its CONDITION and CONCLUSION named at numbers, a DEFINITION with a case under it and a case refused, an AXIOM taken without proof, a LEMMA shown at work inside the proof it serves, a PROOF as a chain whose every link is recounted, a COROLLARY by reapplying the theorem and by its special case, a HYPOTHESIS with its fate (Euler's n*n+n+41 prime for forty values and dead at the forty-first; Goldbach confirmed by a case and proved by none), and a COUNTEREXAMPLE with the law that a confirming case does not save. The whole world is derived from one pair: a number's kind is (divisor, remainder)

worlds.name: longdiv
worlds.genre: LONG DIVISION AS A WALK, NOT A NUMBER — ordered by the band, not by us: `band_reach` found that atlas asks «391 ÷ 17 =» and «5236 ÷ 17 =» while neither number stood once in 194392 lines of shows. Every step of the division is its own checkable equality (take 39; 17 × 2 = 34; 39 − 34 = 5; bring down 1 — 51; 17 × 3 = 51; remainder 0), the ZERO in the middle of a quotient is shown rather than skipped (5236 ÷ 17 = 308), the INVERSE ROAD is a built-in oracle (23 × 17 = 391, and quotient × divisor + remainder = dividend), the refusal is BRACKETED BY TWO COMPUTED MULTIPLES («391 ÷ 19 gives no whole: 19 × 20 = 380, and 19 × 21 = 399 is more than 391»), and column multiplication names its partial products. Divisor and quotient come by range, the dividend is DERIVED as their product; both glyphs of division are written, since two different bands recognise the genus by different ones

worlds.name: ru_conversions
worlds.genre: unit conversion in the RUSSIAN question frame: «сколько минут в двух часах?» — the numeral stands in an oblique case and the unit after it in the prepositional, forms the corpus never showed; every answer carries its GROUND beside the verdict («в часе 60 минут, 60 × 2 = 120»), the ratio is asked of the declared unit graph and never written by hand, the same relation is shown FORWARD by multiplication and BACKWARD by division on the same numbers, and a question across incommensurable units is refused with the ground the court can re-ask of the graph

worlds.name: ru_compare
worlds.genre: multiplicative against differential comparison in Russian: «во сколько раз больше» is DIVISION and «на сколько больше» is SUBTRACTION, two frames a speaker confuses more often than any other, shown on the SAME pair of numbers side by side with the difference between them named aloud; the price frame carries both measures at once; the multiplicative question without a whole answer is refused with the division-with-remainder as its ground, while the differential question on the same pair still answers — which is itself the proof that the frames are two

worlds.name: ru_story
worlds.genre: Russian word problems as EPISODES: one bearer, one thing, an action and a total, where the third fact names its bearer EXPLICITLY («у пети осталось 5 яблок») because a market law is bought only inside one episode; loss and gain share one structure with opposite sign and the Russian turn of phrase follows the sign («отдал … осталось», «купил … стало»); the question surface asks the total instead of stating it, and a question about a person the problem never named is refused with the ground that the court re-checks against the bearer

worlds.name: notationvar
worlds.genre: one sign, two scripts: the same record written in ASCII and in typography, and the court reduces both to one canon. The corpus knew every sign in ONE script only, and in different signs — in DIFFERENT ones: «x^2» 1702 times and «x²» ZERO, «≤» 351 and «<=» ZERO. The gap is invisible to the measure of SUBJECTS (quadratics are shown by the hundred) and was found by the BAND

worlds.name: chelpanov_logika_ru
worlds.genre: Г. И. Челпанов, «Учебник логики» (1897): определение логики, понятие, суждение, умозаключение, доказательство и разбор ошибок — школа рассуждения, писанная до всякой машины

worlds.name: frank_smysl_ru
worlds.genre: С. Л. Франк, «Смысл жизни» (1925): вопрос о смысле как вопрос о знании — что мы вправе утверждать и чем утверждение держится

worlds.name: karpov_vvedenie_ru
worlds.genre: В. Н. Карпов, «Введение в философию» (1840): предмет и границы философского знания, разделение наук, отношение опыта и умозрения

worlds.name: herzen_priroda_ru
worlds.genre: А. И. Герцен, «Письма об изучении природы» (1846): естествознание и философия друг о друге; издательский аппарат академического свода отрезан по своей рубрике

worlds.name: pavlov_mozg_ru
worlds.genre: И. П. Павлов, «Естествознание и мозг» (1909): речь о том, как физиология берётся за высшую нервную деятельность, не заимствуя понятий у психологии

worlds.name: selfmeasure
worlds.genre: the organism speaking about ITSELF, where a self-report is a DATED MEASUREMENT and never an impression (TELOS-DESIGN §4): four genera — state as a fraction bounded by exact integer multiplication, boundary named by number with its complement summing to the whole, need as the DIFFERENCE of two measurements rather than a wish, and growth as the difference of two snapshots of the same day WITH BOTH PARTS NAMED, because a rise in the numerator is not a rise in the share; every show carries the instrument that produced the number and the day it was taken, every show is stated in the PAST tense so it stays true as a historical fact when the instrument moves on, a question surface stands on each genus, and a question about tomorrow is refused on the ground that no measurement later than the named day exists; the court recomputes every relation and additionally requires the pair of numbers to stand in a snapshot declared a second time inside the court, so a corruption consistent with its own arithmetic still breaks

worlds.name: glyphs
worlds.genre: the glyph world v0 (embodied-reasoning mandate 02.09, L5): every symbol — digits, Latin and Cyrillic letters of both cases, signs — as a 5×7 bit grid with a name (tools/glyphs.py, one font table that is also the court's law); shows «grid → symbol», «symbol → grid», negation with a foreign symbol of the same class, questions; words, numbers and TRUE expressions as rows of glyphs through an empty column; the court renders the named symbol and compares cell by cell — recognition stays with the organism (OCR by market)

worlds.name: space
worlds.genre: the spatial world v0 (mandate 02.09, L3): square grids 3×3..5×5 with a figure of filled cells, derived by residues, and executions over them — rotation (90/180/270 clockwise), reflection (left-right, top-bottom), shift without loss, side-neighbour count, shortest path through empty cells with a named refusal when the figure cuts it off, cell count — and questions to each; the executor house tools/spacegrid.py is shared with the court, which re-executes every line; negation takes the result of a sibling executor and is false exactly by computation

worlds.name: stenogram
worlds.genre: interaction transcripts v0 (mandate 02.09, L5: «обучать и интерактиву»): one show in several lines by the declared form declarations/STENOGRAM.md — header with the environment (a grid), steps «action → response» where the response is the environment's whole state after the action or a named refusal (cell outside the grid), and an end line repeating the last response; the court keeps a layer and re-executes each action over the previous state with the same executor house

worlds.name: mathspaces
worlds.genre: mathematical spaces v0 (mandate 02.09, L3; notations agreed with holon): four spans, four groups per pass — Euclidean points «(3, 4)» (exact distance by Pythagorean triples, integer midpoint, shift, reflection, rotation about the origin), graphs «graph 1-2, 2-3, 3-1» (degree with its edges as the ground, vertex and edge counts, shortest path with its vertices, connectivity, a cycle present or absent with the missing edge named, a refusal when no path joins two vertices), the Fano plane «124, 235, 346, 457, 561, 672, 713» (two points on exactly one line, two lines meeting at exactly one point, three lines through a point, a pair not on a line), matrices «[1 2 / 3 4]» (transpose, sum, product with a vector, trace, determinant, row and column); the executor house tools/mathspaces.py is shared with the court, which recomputes every ground after the colon; both polarities on every kind
